Name: No Crows
Author: CatCattyCat
TagLine: This mod stops crows from eating your crops! Now there's no need to worry about scarecrow placement!
Description:
No Crows

This mod makes it so crows won't eat your crops. You no longer have to worry about making sure all of your crops are in range of a scarecrow or watch a crow eat your hard earned star fruit. Scarecrows won't do anything, but you can still place scarecrows for decoration if you want!

**** There is now only one version that works for linux/mac/windows, no need to download a separate one for each platform :) ****

**This mod is compatible with the beta, just download it and install like normal.**

This mod requires[SMAPI](https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases) by PathosChild. To install the mod, place the NoCrows folder in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

If you get an error related to the mod not working, please submit a bug report :).

Also thanks to Eiri for the crossed out crow icon! (It's been slightly enlarged so it doesn't look as good as the original)

[Check out my other mods by clicking here!](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files)
